newsitem.title: USA: Democrat senator hopes to limit Republican clones.
newsitem.headline: Democrat senator hopes to limit Republican clones.

text.p: The leader of the Senate's minority Democrats said Monday the United States should ban cloning of humans, but if it does not, there is a list of those he wants to make sure are not duplicated.
A laughing Sen. Tom Daschle of South Dakota told reporters he was taking a stand against using this scientific procedure to create humans.

"I'm against cloning and I don't care who knows it," he said with mock seriousness at his regular news conference when asked whether the United States should follow Britain's lead with a law against cloning humans.

Asked by chuckling reporters if there were any particular people he wanted to make sure were not cloned, especially his Republican opponents, Daschle replied: "Exactly. There is a list that I'll divulge at some point in the future."
"This could get real serious," he said with a smile.
